info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Document Retrieval API
info.description: The Document Retrieval API facilitates access to essential banking documents needed for customer verification and compliance processes. This endpoint allows users to retrieve specific document details by providing a designated parameter. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers utilizing this information to enhance their customer service capabilities. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their document management tasks and improve regulatory adherence.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about document services identified by a specific ID (RES-100045). It returns relevant metadata and attributes associated with the document services, facilitating easy access to necessary information.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the document details associated with the specified document service identifier. Ensure that the required parameters are provided correctly for a successful retrieval.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the requested document.

GetDocumentServicesByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body structure for the GET operation on document services.

GetDocumentServicesByIdResponse_200.title: Document Response Schema

documentId.description: The unique identifier for the document.

retentionClass.description: The retention class of the document.

ownerId.description: The identifier of the owner of the document.

fileName.description: The name of the file associated with the document.

mediaType.description: The media type of the document.

checksumSha256.description: The SHA256 checksum of the document for data integrity verification.

recordStatus.description: The status of the document record.

version.description: The version number of the document.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of when the document was last updated.

GetDocumentServicesByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the details of a document retrieved from the document service.

DocumentMetadata.title: Document Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response associated with the document metadata.

correlationId.description: An identifier used to correlate related requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the document processing took place.

DocumentMetadata.description: Schema representing metadata details for a document.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint used in the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application runtime processing the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer Authentication, where the client must include a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header to authenticate requests. The JWT must be properly formatted and signed.
